creator: Alexander Terp
description: Alex's chat note, 2026-07-04: "if not rad fmt, catch in rad check?" Today the two disagree: on a badly formatted script, rad check --strict prints "No diagnostics to report" while rad fmt --check exits 1. rad check could report a formatting diagnostic (likely at hint or info level) so one command covers both.
title: rad check: report scripts that rad fmt would change
